question.text: The Dividend Discount Model (DDM) is MOST suitable for valuing:

explanation.text: The Logic: The DDM values a company based on the present value of its expected dividends and is therefore most suitable for companies that regularly pay dividends. The Trap: Firms that do not pay dividends are better valued using cash-flow approaches such as FCFE rather than DDM. Note: Source: NISM-Series-XXI-A PMS Distributors workbook, p.46 (DDM); p.49 (FCFE contrast).
